## PageValueType interface

The value type of a [Page](./contracts.page.md)<!-- -->, made with [ValueTypeConstructors.page()](./contracts.valuetypeconstructors.page.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface PageValueType<T> extends ValueType<Page<T>>
```

**Extends:** [ValueType](./contracts.valuetype.md)<!-- -->&lt;[Page](./contracts.page.md)<!-- -->&lt;T&gt;&gt;

## Remarks

It is an ordinary value type of `Page<T>` that also exposes the value type of one item, so that code which needs the items without the page (a collection reference resolves to an array of items, not a page) derives that from the same composition.
